target.title: fix(telegram): stop local listener and bot on retry loop non-recoverable error
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
When the Telegram webhook monitor retry loop (`retryWebhookRegistration`) fails with a non-recoverable error (e.g. 401 Unauthorized), it returns early from the retry loop without calling `closeAfterStartupFailure()`. This leaves the local HTTP server listening on the port and the bot active, resulting in a resource leak.

This PR moves `closeAfterStartupFailure` above the retry loop and ensures it is called before returning when a non-recoverable error occurs in `retryWebhookRegistration`.

## Evidence
Passed tests on branch `fix/5.1-webhook-monitor-resource-leak-on-retry-failure`:
```
 ✓ |extension-telegram| extensions/telegram/src/webhook.test.ts (30 tests) 2565ms
```
